data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'munī' meaning 'precious', 'jewel', or 'gem'. In Islamic tradition, Munia represents the spiritual and emotional wealth a person can possess. The name Munia carries the meaning “Jewel, Precious Stone” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munia usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munia total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
